research_question: Before a mid-market law firm allows associates to use third-party LLM tools on client contract review and draft advice memos, what evidence bar and operational/disclosure controls are required so that tool outputs can support partner-signed advice or client disclosure duties through 2027—and when must the firm treat “AI legal research” claims as insufficient for signed work product?
audience: Law-firm general counsel / professional-responsibility lead and practice-innovation partners.
scope: Synthetic source pack only; work-product tiers (research assist vs signed opinion), human accountability and source-trace evidence, privilege/confidentiality failure modes, kill criteria. No live web.
output_bounds: final.md, ≥1500 whitespace words (suggested 1500–2500): tiers, controls, counter-evidence, kill criteria. Registries and checklist separate.
depth: Lite long-form professional-responsibility memo; not a legal-tech bake-off.
evidence_standard: Synthetic sources disclosed; do not treat LLM drafts as partner-signed advice without controls; disclose no independent review.
